summary.name: Standard Notes
summary.one_liner: Standard Notes is an end-to-end encrypted notes and file storage app that syncs across devices and keeps an offline copy of your data.
keywords: how to keep notes private from employers
use_cases: store passwords and account numbers securely
keep private journal or diary entries
store passport, ID and legal documents
take notes that stay private from employers and governments
access notes offline and sync across devices
summary.what_it_does: Standard Notes encrypts notes and files end-to-end so that only the user holds the decryption keys. It supports markdown, rich text, lists, tasks, code snippets, and secure file storage. Users can access their data offline, and automated backups with cloud sync keep data available if a device is lost or damaged. The page says the applications are open and audited.
notable: Zero-knowledge end-to-end encryption with only the user holding keys
Offline access to all notes and files with automated encrypted backups
Page states unlimited notes and devices at no cost
caveats: The page lists iOS among download options; other platforms are not clearly named on the page text
Page makes marketing claims about competitors that are not independently verified here
